AcceptanceCriterion.description: One independently verifiable condition for Task delivery.
AcceptanceCriterion.title: AcceptanceCriterion

AgentPermissions.description: The executable path, command, network, and state capabilities of an Agent.
AgentPermissions.title: AgentPermissions

AgentRequest.description: Immutable input envelope supplied to one Agent adapter invocation.
AgentRequest.title: AgentRequest

AgentRole.description: Delivery-runtime roles bound to Task artifacts and state transitions.
AgentRole.title: AgentRole

BaselineExecutionFacts.description: Trusted collector output, never accepted from an API/model request body.
BaselineExecutionFacts.title: BaselineExecutionFacts

BaselineExecutionReservation.description: Exact current-call accounting, consumed only by the fenced queue service.
BaselineExecutionReservation.title: BaselineExecutionReservation

DeliveryFailureFacts.description: Facts from trusted application services, never model routing suggestions.
DeliveryFailureFacts.title: DeliveryFailureFacts

DeliveryResolution.description: A real engineering decision, sealed before queue consumption and never a verdict.
DeliveryResolution.title: DeliveryResolution

DeliveryWaitCollectionFailure.description: Safe bounded diagnosis; no rejected body, path or exception text.
DeliveryWaitCollectionFailure.title: DeliveryWaitCollectionFailure

DeliveryWaitHandling.description: Immutable platform handling report, separate from execution and verdict.
DeliveryWaitHandling.title: DeliveryWaitHandling

DeliveryWaitInvestigation.description: Trusted collector observation. Request fields cannot assert stop or readiness.
DeliveryWaitInvestigation.title: DeliveryWaitInvestigation

EngineeringAdmission.description: One exact application of policy, distinct from RecoveryAuthorization.
EngineeringAdmission.title: EngineeringAdmission

EngineeringDispositionRecord.description: Durable compatibility decision; it never reopens an original terminal Task.
EngineeringDispositionRecord.title: EngineeringDispositionRecord

EngineeringPolicy.description: Versioned organization decision frozen only on newly admitted Tasks.
EngineeringPolicy.title: EngineeringPolicy

ExecutionBaselineBinding.description: One completed source rebind, never a role verdict or a new Product approval.
ExecutionBaselineBinding.title: ExecutionBaselineBinding

InterruptionContinuationPolicy.description: Frozen narrow capability; legacy Tasks have no implicit authorization.
InterruptionContinuationPolicy.title: InterruptionContinuationPolicy

KnowledgePreparationRetryEvidence.description: Exact stopped knowledge preparation and its finite, frozen next window.
KnowledgePreparationRetryEvidence.title: KnowledgePreparationRetryEvidence

LegacyExecutionContainment.description: Exact new engineering facts, separate from an original process-stop receipt.
LegacyExecutionContainment.title: LegacyExecutionContainment

LegacyRescuePreparation.description: Bound prerequisite check, separate from human authorization and old Run outcome.
LegacyRescuePreparation.title: LegacyRescuePreparation

LocalBootObservation.description: Stable boot identity, with raw device identifiers never stored or displayed.
LocalBootObservation.title: LocalBootObservation

LocalOperatorPrincipal.description: Trusted local composition identity; request/model text cannot add duties.
LocalOperatorPrincipal.title: LocalOperatorPrincipal

ModelSelection.description: Concrete, run-scoped model allocation with machine-readable reasons.
ModelSelection.title: ModelSelection

NativeRuleKind.description: Project-native guidance source categories, not interpreted priorities.
NativeRuleKind.title: NativeRuleKind

NativeRuleSource.description: A UTF-8 project-native rule source represented without absolute paths.
NativeRuleSource.title: NativeRuleSource

OriginalInvocationAuthority.description: Original producer identity from a real historical claim, never request text.
OriginalInvocationAuthority.title: OriginalInvocationAuthority

PytestSelection.description: A specific test function/class method, possibly parametrized; never a suite root.
PytestSelection.title: PytestSelection

QueueClaim.description: Durable assignment/model/Lease bundle returned to one worker.
QueueClaim.title: QueueClaim

QueuedWorkItem.description: One executable delivery-role Run in the organization queue.
QueuedWorkItem.title: QueuedWorkItem

RecoveryScopeRequest.description: Operator-selected exact missing files, bound to accepted Coder progress.
RecoveryScopeRequest.title: RecoveryScopeRequest

RejectedCoderOutputEvidence.description: A stopped rejected progress report, never an interruption or a candidate.
RejectedCoderOutputEvidence.title: RejectedCoderOutputEvidence

RetainedExecutionPatch.description:
Reference to complete old execution-base → candidate + dirty mutation bodies.

Trusted collection must validate the body and URI before this reference is
published. A digest alone never permits discarding a dirty worktree.
RetainedExecutionPatch.title: RetainedExecutionPatch

RoleAssignment.description: Temporary binding of an organization Agent to one Task role and lease.
RoleAssignment.title: RoleAssignment

Task.description: A bounded request tied to one repository and delivery state.
Task.title: Task

TaskConstraints.description: Machine-consumable restrictions attached to a Task.
TaskConstraints.title: TaskConstraints

TaskLease.description: Expiring claim on Agent capacity for one RoleAssignment.
TaskLease.title: TaskLease

VerificationRetryEvidence.description: A real inconclusive QA result on a retained candidate, never a code defect.
VerificationRetryEvidence.title: VerificationRetryEvidence

VerifierPreparationEvidence.description: Exact pre-model native execution facts, never an inferred provider failure.
VerifierPreparationEvidence.title: VerifierPreparationEvidence

CompletedCoderOutputUnavailableProof.description: Original FAILED result plus real stop, never a workspace-ready declaration.
CompletedCoderOutputUnavailableProof.title: CompletedCoderOutputUnavailableProof

ExecutionCaptureStart.description: Original claimed inventory, sealed before the native invocation starts.
ExecutionCaptureStart.title: ExecutionCaptureStart

ExecutionCaptureStop.description: Owned-runner final observation; it grants no retry or artifact authority.
ExecutionCaptureStop.title: ExecutionCaptureStop

NativeProcessStop.description: Legacy leader/group stop, optionally with a new explicit owned-SID proof.
NativeProcessStop.title: NativeProcessStop

AgentResult.description: Immutable typed output; success and failure states are mutually exclusive.
AgentResult.title: AgentResult

AgentErrorCode.description: Stable failure categories consumed by Orchestrator retry routing.
AgentErrorCode.title: AgentErrorCode

AgentFailure.description: Typed failure evidence with an explicit retry classification.
AgentFailure.title: AgentFailure

AgentRunStatus.description: Terminal status of one isolated Agent Run.
AgentRunStatus.title: AgentRunStatus

AgentUsage.description: Provider-neutral token usage reported for one Agent Run.
AgentUsage.title: AgentUsage

AgentProducer.description: The Agent Run identity that produced an Artifact.
AgentProducer.title: AgentProducer

Evidence.description: A stable reference to independently inspectable proof.
Evidence.title: Evidence

ArtifactIntegrity.description: ArtifactStore-owned validation state and content digest.
ArtifactIntegrity.title: ArtifactIntegrity

CoderProgressContent.description: A non-candidate implementation checkpoint that requests another bounded Coder run.
CoderProgressContent.title: CoderProgressContent

Finding.description: A severity-rated issue linked to one or more Evidence entries.
Finding.title: Finding

ProjectObservation.description: A scoped discovery proposal, never a verdict or executable policy.
ProjectObservation.title: ProjectObservation

PlannedVerificationInspection.description: An explicit approved inspection target, never a test or verdict.
PlannedVerificationInspection.title: PlannedVerificationInspection

StoppedProviderFailureProof.description: Original permanent failure and exact native stop, never a health assertion.
StoppedProviderFailureProof.title: StoppedProviderFailureProof

PausedInvocationProof.description: Trusted stopped/no-start execution bound to one exact admitted request.
PausedInvocationProof.title: PausedInvocationProof

SynchronousToolLoopStop.description:
Trusted observation after a synchronous Responses route and its tools returned.

This is not a native process-group observation. The provider generates data;
only the bounded local registry runs tools, sequentially and synchronously.
An interrupted Host cannot create this receipt, nor can request/model text.
SynchronousToolLoopStop.title: SynchronousToolLoopStop

StoppedCoderExecutionProof.description: Exact real start/stop and historical claim, never an invented result or cause.
StoppedCoderExecutionProof.title: StoppedCoderExecutionProof

ExecutionAbortReason.description: Safe trusted authority facts, never provider text or an automatic retry cause.
ExecutionAbortReason.title: ExecutionAbortReason

StoppedFailureProof.description: Exact stopped unclassified failure; no inferred cause or provider health assertion.
StoppedFailureProof.title: StoppedFailureProof

RejectedKnowledgePreparationEvidence.description: Current exact rejection proof; no expansion or refund of the old call.
RejectedKnowledgePreparationEvidence.title: RejectedKnowledgePreparationEvidence

RejectedWorkspaceAdmissionEvidence.description: Positive trusted adapter refusal before provider execution, never a native stop.
RejectedWorkspaceAdmissionEvidence.title: RejectedWorkspaceAdmissionEvidence

WorkspaceAdmissionAdapterContract.description: Operator input; principal and time come only from trusted composition.
WorkspaceAdmissionAdapterContract.title: WorkspaceAdmissionAdapterContract

KnowledgePreparationIsolationProof.description: An exact present observation, never an original no-start or stop receipt.
KnowledgePreparationIsolationProof.title: KnowledgePreparationIsolationProof

KnowledgeInvocationOutcome.description: A returned model value is data, never a knowledge or delivery verdict.
KnowledgeInvocationOutcome.title: KnowledgeInvocationOutcome

StructuredPreAdmissionPauseReceipt.description: A refusal is neither an admission nor proof that a started process stopped.
StructuredPreAdmissionPauseReceipt.title: StructuredPreAdmissionPauseReceipt

StructuredNativeNotStartedReceipt.description: The owned runner failed before creating a process; this is not a stop.
StructuredNativeNotStartedReceipt.title: StructuredNativeNotStartedReceipt

StructuredHttpRoundTripReceipt.description: The local synchronous transport returned; remote work may still be running.
StructuredHttpRoundTripReceipt.title: StructuredHttpRoundTripReceipt

TeamRole.description: Long-lived roles that a Team-owned AgentProfile may declare.
TeamRole.title: TeamRole

RejectedCandidateOutputProof.description:
Original successful output and a separately observed lawful candidate.

``publication_absent`` seals the trusted collector's fresh absence checks. It
is not an absence proof derived from the Agent's report or a database query.
The fixed rejection contract keeps historical decoding independent of future
changes to the platform's currently supported artifact version.
RejectedCandidateOutputProof.title: RejectedCandidateOutputProof
